name: Hotel Gasthof Fuchs
beschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Fuchs is located in Matrei am Brenner within Tyrol's scenic Wipptal valley. Framed by the peaks of the Stubai and Zillertal Alps, the inn offers alpine-style guest rooms and a welcoming restaurant serving genuine Tyrolean fare. In summer, visitors enjoy direct access to panoramic hiking trails, while winter brings proximity to ski areas like Bergeralm and Stubai. Facilities include a restorative sauna and sunbathing lawns.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Fuchs in Matrei am Brenner provides traditional Tyrolean hospitality, an on-site sauna, authentic regional dining, and easy access to Wipptal ski slopes and trails.
